kind: Synthetic browser-response fixtures; not live model acceptance
checks: Desktop primary action is visible without scrolling
Replacing nonempty notes requires a choice
Duplicate form submissions produce only one POST
Valid response creates three action cards
Opening edit focuses its title field
Keyboard completion toggle updates the count
Markdown export includes original source wording
Changing notes labels existing results as stale
Server error keeps previous action cards
Cancellation ignores a late model response
Mobile edit form does not overflow
Escape closes edit without changing the action
An empty successful response disables export
Rejected-only output does not claim there are no actions
Unmatched quotes are never rendered as action cards
App creates no localStorage or sessionStorage entries
